rule: Assumption register (FRAMEWORK.md area 13(b); S6 CIO challenge Q1 and D2): every constant Sovereign IQ v4 scoring, exposure and delivery planning use, with value, basis, confidence and what changes if it is wrong. The report's 'How we calculated this' appendix shows the arithmetic; this register shows the constants. The test packages/engine-core/test/sovereign-iq-v4-report.test.ts checks the values against the code.

basisValues.published_source: Published source with a claim ID in the claims register
basisValues.ltm_heuristic: LTM heuristic with reasoning; not a market fact
basisValues.design_decision: Design rule approved by the product owner

assumptions.title: State values
assumptions.value: In place 1; largely in place 2/3; partly in place 1/3; not in place 0
assumptions.sensitivity: Equal steps; a control that is largely in place counts for two thirds. Uneven steps would move scores by a few points, not the band order
assumptions.reasoning: Equal steps keep the scale explainable and match the four answer options; no published weighting exists for these controls.

assumptions.title: Unknown and blank answers
assumptions.value: "Unknown" counts as not in place (0) and is listed as unconfirmed; an unanswered question counts as 0 and is listed as not answered
assumptions.sensitivity: A blank never flatters the score; confirming an unknown control can only raise it

assumptions.title: Control weights
assumptions.sensitivity: Checked against ten public reference scenarios; changing a weight moves maturity by up to about 10 points
assumptions.reasoning: A missing critical control (data location, transfer basis, key custody, provider access) defeats the sovereignty objective on its own; supporting controls reduce risk at the margin.

assumptions.title: Smallest scored set
assumptions.value: A maturity number is shown only when at least 5 controls are required
assumptions.sensitivity: Below 5, one answer could move the score by more than 20 points, so each control's state is shown instead

assumptions.title: Maturity bands
assumptions.value: 80 and above Sovereign-ready; 60 to 79 Managed; 40 to 59 Developing; below 40 Exposed. Sovereign-ready is not shown while a finding is critical or a regulation is red
assumptions.sensitivity: A score near a boundary can change band with one answer; the score itself is shown beside the band
assumptions.reasoning: Bands follow the common four-step maturity reading; the top band is withheld when a single gap would undermine the claim.

assumptions.title: Required level
assumptions.value: The highest of the legal localisation minimum, the board's choice and any EU tender minimum, per kind of data
assumptions.sensitivity: A lower board choice removes the controls of the higher level; see "What a lower level would change"

assumptions.title: Default allowed region
assumptions.value: When no region is given: headquarters plus where the people are (personal, sensitive personal and financial data) or where the group has entities (other data)
assumptions.sensitivity: A wider allowed region turns some location gaps into control in place

assumptions.title: Regulation rating
assumptions.value: Red when a critical or high-weight required control is absent, unconfirmed or not answered; amber when any required control is below full; green when all are in place
assumptions.sensitivity: A rating, not a probability of enforcement

assumptions.title: Turnover for statutory maximums
assumptions.value: The worldwide turnover given; otherwise both ends of the turnover band, shown as a range; not quantified without either. Limbs on a turnover the assessment does not collect (in-country, adjusted) are not computed, and the maximum reads "at least"
assumptions.sensitivity: A maximum is a cap, not an expected fine; caps are never added together

assumptions.title: Exchange rates
assumptions.value: ECB euro reference rates of 12 Oct 2026, used to rank caps in different currencies and to convert into the turnover currency
assumptions.sensitivity: A 10% currency move changes a converted cap by 10% and can change which regulation has the largest cap

assumptions.title: Severity
assumptions.value: From the control's weight, whether a regulation that applies or a level of L2 or above needs it, and its state
assumptions.sensitivity: Severity sets when work starts, not how long it takes

assumptions.title: Start of work
assumptions.value: Critical: start in month 1; high: month 2; medium: month 4; low: month 7; decisions and scope confirmations: month 1. A prerequisite starts as early as the most urgent action that needs it; a dependent starts once each prerequisite is expected to reach its milestone (the end of its duration)
assumptions.sensitivity: A programme with more capacity starts more in parallel; the order of dependent work does not change
assumptions.reasoning: Urgent gaps start first; prerequisites move forward with what depends on them, so no action starts before what it needs is in place.

assumptions.title: Effort and duration
assumptions.value: Per control: effort S (up to one FTE-month), M (one to three FTE-months), L (three to nine), XL (a programme of several teams); duration is typical elapsed time. Moving data to a sovereign offering is XL, 9 to 18 months
assumptions.sensitivity: Discovery may lengthen or shorten each item; a statement of work replaces these bands
assumptions.reasoning: Durations reflect the type of work: policy and register work in weeks to months, platform changes in a quarter or two, migrations over a year.

assumptions.title: Processing location
assumptions.value: Processing in a country without an entity there does not by itself bring that country's law into scope
assumptions.sensitivity: A law with extraterritorial reach on processing alone would add a regulation; confirm with counsel
